sentences.en: But making these, you know, I don't want to sound obvious, but, you know, these movies that have melancholy in them, there's definitely funny things in them, too.
sentences.zh: 但制作这些，你知道的，我不想听起来像是在说废话，但是，你知道，这些带有一点忧郁色彩的电影里，其实也绝对有很多搞笑的元素。

sentences.en: But he's so oblivious and so, so, so fleeing from the horrible reality of his life.
sentences.zh: 但他却如此浑然不觉，如此拼命地、拼命地、拼命地逃避他生活中可怕的现实。

sentences.en: He doesn't even bother to take the damn pins out of the back.

sentences.en: So that's kind of, the unknowing of, like, what's funny about your own life is amusing when you do see it.

sentences.en: And I appreciate it in my own life.

sentences.en: And it's great to show the obliviousness of it on the screen.

sentences.en: Your part in The Friend, in a way, reminds me of some other relatively recent parts from your career.

sentences.en: In that he's sort of a charismatic, charming guy who's also been sort of a selfish ding-dong.

sentences.zh: 有点什么？

sentences.en: It could mean punishment.
sentences.zh: 也可以意味着惩罚。

sentences.en: What would it mean to say taking on a role is like a form of penance?

sentences.en: And did that apply to Walter also?
sentences.zh: 这同时也适用于沃尔特吗？

sentences.en: I think I have, you know, those definitions are accurate.
sentences.zh: 我想我有，你知道的，那些定义是准确的。

sentences.en: The one I would kind of lean toward myself is that you have to suffer to play it.
sentences.zh: 我更倾向于认同的那一种是，你必须为了扮演它而遭受痛苦。

sentences.en: Like, it's not to play a complete jerk or what did you call it?

sentences.en: It's pretty sweet.

sentences.en: I liked it.
sentences.zh: 我挺喜欢的。

sentences.zh: 所以为了演一个自私的笨蛋，这事儿稍微扯远一点。

sentences.en: One of my, in this movie, the friend, I have someone that's had three wives.

sentences.en: And one of my wives is such a horrible creature that I finally ran into her not at work just a few weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 其中一个妻子是个极其可怕的家伙，以至于就在几周前，我不是在工作场合偶然碰到了她。

sentences.en: So that really was great acting.
sentences.zh: 所以那真的是非常出色的演技。

sentences.en: But for me, the penance is like having to live and be the part of that person that you really have to make people uncomfortable.

sentences.en: You really make people feel it.

sentences.en: You know, I work with those fools.

sentences.en: It really hurts.

sentences.zh: 你喜欢这种感觉，还是说一想到20秒后我可能会变成另一个人，会让你觉得很不踏实？

sentences.en: Well, I only like it if I see what a horrible...
sentences.zh: 嗯，只有当我看到自己有多糟糕的时候，我才喜欢……

sentences.en: Well, it's not fair.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这不公平。

sentences.en: If you see what you're up to, you should like it.
sentences.zh: 如果你看清自己在做什么，你应该会喜欢。

sentences.en: You know, whether it's you're being horrible or you're being wonderful.
sentences.zh: 你知道，不管是表现得糟糕还是表现得美妙。

sentences.en: If you see it, that's great.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到了，那就太棒了。

sentences.en: Score, you know, score one.
sentences.zh: 得分，你知道，算一分。

sentences.en: Get a...
sentences.zh: 拿一个……

sentences.en: You get a star for that.
sentences.zh: 你因此得到一颗星。

sentences.en: Because the awareness is what's important.
sentences.zh: 因为这种觉知才是最重要的。

sentences.en: Yeah, the awareness of, like, being what you are.
sentences.zh: 对，那种觉知，就像，认清自我的觉知。

sentences.en: You know, that has value.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这有价值。

sentences.en: That's being awake.
sentences.zh: 那就是觉醒。

sentences.en: There's no value to being just rolling through.
sentences.zh: 随波逐流没有任何价值。

sentences.en: You know, you don't...
sentences.zh: 你知道，你不会……

sentences.en: You know, they just put you in a grave at the end.
sentences.zh: 你知道，到头来他们只是把你放进坟墓里。

sentences.en: You didn't do anything.
sentences.zh: 你什么也没做。

sentences.en: I want to finish with a little section from the novel, The Friend.
sentences.zh: 我想以小说《朋友》中的一小段来结束。

sentences.en: I'm just curious.
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇。

sentences.en: Somehow I knew he was going to read aloud.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，我早知道他要朗读了。

sentences.en: At some point during this thing, I knew he was going to read aloud from something.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中的某个时刻，我就知道他会朗读点什么。

sentences.en: Do I give that vibe?
sentences.zh: 我给人这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: The kind of guy who is into recitations?
sentences.zh: 那种喜欢朗诵的家伙？

sentences.en: Well, I know you didn't have any of your own poetry, which is a big plus, but go ahead.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我知道你没有带你自己的诗，这很不错，但请继续吧。

sentences.en: Wait for it.
sentences.zh: 拭目以待。

sentences.en: Wait for it.
sentences.zh: 拭目以待。

sentences.en: Wait for it.
sentences.zh: 拭目以待。

sentences.en: This is right near the end of an novel.
sentences.zh: 这就在小说快结束的地方。

sentences.en: What we miss, what we lose, and what we mourn, isn't it this that makes us who deep down we truly are, to say nothing of what we wanted in life, but never got to have?
sentences.zh: 我们所错过的、所失去的、所哀悼的，不正是这一切造就了我们内心的真正自我吗？更不用说我们在生活中梦寐以求却从未得到的东西了？

sentences.en: So my question for you is, what haven't you gotten that you wanted, and what did you get that you wanted?
sentences.zh: 所以我的问题是，你有什么想要却没得到，又得到了什么想要的？

sentences.en: Well, I don't know which to say firSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不知道该先说哪一个。

sentences.en: Say the sadder one first, and let's end on an up note.
sentences.zh: 先说悲伤的那个，让我们以积极的调子结束。

sentences.en: Well, the sadder one is I haven't gotten, you know, I want to think about, you know, I don't want to really sound too damn special here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，悲伤的是我还没得到，你知道的，我想考虑一下，你知道，我真的不想让自己听起来太特别。

sentences.en: I haven't gotten where I'm active all the time.
sentences.zh: 我还没能做到时时刻刻都保持活跃。

sentences.en: Active meaning aware.
sentences.zh: 活跃的意思是保持觉知。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I haven't gotten so that I'm much more of a person, a being, than I am now, you know.
sentences.zh: 我还没能成为一个更具主体性、更有存在感的人，你知道的。

sentences.en: I haven't gotten there.
sentences.zh: 我还没达到那种境界。

sentences.en: But what I have gotten was the opportunity, the knowledge that, like, hey, there's a way to do this.
sentences.zh: 但我得到的是机遇，是这样一种认知：嘿，原来有这样一种方法。

sentences.en: If only you had the guts or the inner resources to do it, you know, if you were just tougher
sentences.zh: 只要你有勇气或内心资源去做到这一点，你知道，如果你对自己更严厉

sentences.en: on yourself, you know, if you were just more demanding, not so lazy, not so unconscious, you know, all of this, but you can rally, you know, the rallies are extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 一点，你知道，如果你要求更高，不那么懒惰，不那么无意识，你知道，所有这些，但你能振作起来，你知道，振作起来的感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: The rallies are great.
sentences.zh: 振作起来的感觉真好。

sentences.en: The rallies are great.
sentences.zh: 振作起来的感觉真好。

sentences.en: And, um, and they give you hope, and, and, um, and it's the hope for a rally that, that really keeps me going.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，而且它们给了你希望，而且，嗯，正是对振作的希望，才真正让我坚持下去。

sentences.en: I really hope for a rally.
sentences.zh: 我真的渴望能振作起来。

sentences.en: All the time.
sentences.zh: 一直如此。

sentences.en: You feel one coming on?
sentences.zh: 你觉得那种状态要来了吗？

sentences.en: This is a rally.
sentences.zh: 这就是振作。
